counted_approaches.method: Small rational candidate and finite-complement elimination
counted_approaches.result: Conditional CP2 criterion, rational-vector-space kernel averaging theorem, and explicit algebraic countermodel to torsion-free-kernel sufficiency
counted_approaches.gap: No torsion-free or cocycle-triviality theorem established for the actual smooth CP2 kernel

counted_approaches.result: Exact realization of linear finite subgroups and conjugates, with invariant flat metrics; affine maps add no new mapping classes
counted_approaches.gap: No control of all finite subgroups in the full smooth mapping class group of T4

counted_approaches.result: Every finite subgroup of the orientation-preserving standard product-and-swap subgroup is realized, via a proved finite wreath-subgroup conjugation lemma
counted_approaches.gap: No theorem conjugates arbitrary finite smooth mapping-class subgroups into the standard subgroup

counted_approaches.result: Exact fixed-metric-orbit plus stabilizer-splitting criterion; Pin(2) demonstrates why the splitting condition cannot be dropped abstractly
counted_approaches.gap: No suitable universal finite-group fixed-point and splitting theorem established for a candidate four-manifold

counted_approaches.result: Necessary elementary-abelian rank bounds for primes not dividing Euler characteristic; local-support periodicity boundary lemma
counted_approaches.gap: No source of over-rank smooth mapping-class subgroups on every possible candidate; Euler-zero cases remain outside this obstruction
